source: FAOSTAT (FAO), Pakistan: Crops and livestock products (QCL) yield; Producer Prices (PP) annual
method: Yield = mean of the latest 3 FAOSTAT years (national average, all irrigation types).
Price = latest annual FAOSTAT producer price, nominal PKR per tonne (not adjusted for inflation).
National averages: local yields and prices can differ a lot. No production costs are included.

notes: FAOSTAT item 'Rice' is paddy (unmilled) rice for all varieties; basmati and coarse rice prices differ a lot.
FAOSTAT price changed 1.9x between 2022 (150,596) and 2024 (284,830 PKR/t); check against a local market price.
No FAOSTAT item for mung bean in Pakistan ('Beans, dry' is a different crop); enter local values.
Berseem is a fodder crop with no FAOSTAT yield or price; enter local values.
